findings.text: The new single _ledger_row carries the unreadable-row refusal and the foreign-run-id guard with no test, and because both callers now depend on that one copy, dropping the row.get("run_id") != run_id check would let another run's row answer as this run's without reddening any test.
The importer arm the done_when names was run at 6892c102b2 and never at the landed head 853c0979, so the refactor's effect on queue_landing's importers is unmeasured at the revision this review read.

item_verdicts.diff: Read 95c0e0db9a..853c0979 commit by commit; one file changed. The two ledger-row reads collapse into _ledger_row at reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:33, _promoted_row_head and _landed_elsewhere both derive from it, and every branch -- absent row, unreadable row, foreign run id, promoted_revision read -- keeps its prior answer.
item_verdicts.done_when: The reviewed done_when asks for the section's test with its negative control, no added importer failure against base and clean ruff; after-suite-repair.log records 54 passed with EXIT=0 at 853c09794dfd and baseline-suite-repair.log records 49 passed with two instrument setup errors and EXIT=1 at 85bbe4ec02, ruff check and format are clean on the file at head (measured here), but no importer arm was run at the landed head -- head-arm-importers.log:1 names 6892c102b2.
item_verdicts.goal: The reviewed node's goal is that a refused landing writes nothing; this increment, commit 853c0979, changes only the ledger-row read at reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:33-67 and leaves the cited-head behaviour the goal rests on unchanged.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records 853c0979 as the reuse repair, carries after_suite at revision 853c09794dfd (54 passed, EXIT=0) and baseline_suite at 85bbe4ec02 (49 passed, two setup errors), and its finding-reuse-a/b/c entries answer the prior review's three findings; its artifacts line's 9-failure figure matches after-arm-lander.log and its 10-failure figure matches head-arm-importers.log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The reviewed manifest declares six write paths including reckon/crew/queue_landing.py; the increment changes exactly that one file, 11 insertions and 18 deletions, and nothing outside the fence.
